scripts.install:all: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend && npm run install:scripts
scripts.install:scripts: cd scripts && npm init -y && npm install dotenv
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && cross-env NODE_ENV=development npm run dev
scripts.dev:frontend: cd frontend && npm run dev -- --mode development
scripts.start:backend: cd backend && cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm start
scripts.start:frontend: cd frontend && npm run build && npm run preview -- --mode production
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm run build -- --mode production
scripts.build:test: cd frontend && npm run build -- --mode test
scripts.build:dev: cd frontend && npm run build -- --mode development
scripts.release:test: npm run pre-release:test && npm run build:test
scripts.release:prod: npm run pre-release:prod && npm run build
